_comment: Maps each Drive sub-folder to a hall on the website. 'drive_names' are compared ignoring emoji, brackets, spaces and capital letters, so '☘️ [Slides]-Mascot' matches 'Slides Mascot'. Order here = order on the website. 'frame' is 'square' or 'wide' (16:10, good for wallpapers).
